name: Orange Bread
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Cover grated orange peel with water and boil for 5 minutes.
Barely cover with cold water (about ¼ cup).
Add ½ cup sugar and cook until peel is tender and water is cooked away; cool.
Mix thoroughly egg, 1 cup sugar, melted butter, baking powder, all-purpose flour, milk, and salt.
Add cooled peel to this mixture and mix well.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3 inch (23 x 13 x 8 cm) pan.
Bake in the preheated oven for about 55–65 minutes or until a toothpick comes out dry when inserted in the loaf.

culture.text: This recipe for orange bread, originally called "Grandma-Ag's orange bread" by the recipe contributor, makes a quickbread flavored with orange peel. From the original contributor:"This bread is a fond memory of my childhood, visiting Agnes Frances Primm, my Grandma-Ag. As a young adult, I tried to duplicate the recipe, and unable, I went back and begged her for the secrets of it. When I asked her how long it had taken to develop the tricky recipe, she flattened my ego by telling me she'd gotten it out of a magazine years before! I like to make it for Christmas."
